valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 comparable diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing, no ADR conversion. Anchors: FY2025 comparable EPS $3.00 (Feb 10 2026 release); FY2026 comparable EPS growth guidance raised in the Q3 release of Oct 27 2026 to at least 11% per press reports (about $3.33; the guidance table was an image I could not read directly); Q3 comparable EPS $0.91 (+11%), comparable operating margin 32.9%, YTD FCF $11.4B. FY2027 EPS is my own assumption: roughly 6-7% growth, with a currency tailwind fading and the planned Coca-Cola Beverages Africa sale flagged by management as a 2027 headwind (press-reported).

bear.driver: Currency tailwind reverses, volume slows from 5% growth, CCBA divestiture and higher input costs weigh; staples de-rate as rates stay high.

base.driver: Organic revenue growth of about 5% and modest margin gains lift EPS about 6.5% from roughly $3.33 in FY2026, partly offset by CCBA sale dilution; multiple holds near the current premium.

bull.driver: Sustained volume and pricing momentum with margin expansion beyond 33%, buybacks and favorable FX; defensive premium multiple persists.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $3.55 the $99.25 close implies 28.0x; the equal-weight average of the pre-close named targets ($98.3) implies 27.7x, or about $3.51 EPS at 28x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.55 (about 3.6 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Global unit case volume growth (Q3 2026: 5%) and comparable operating margin (Q3 2026: 32.9%), plus 2027 comparable EPS guidance including the CCBA sale effect.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with initial 2027 guidance, expected mid-February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Six named analysts through the Nov 13 close, all from one aggregator table: four Buys (BofA, DBS, Evercore ISI, UBS) and two Holds (Bernstein, Freedom Capital Markets). Five targets range from $89 to $106 (equal-weight average $98.8) with the close at $99.25, so the named group implies roughly flat price returns, close to my base case; the gap is about 0 pp, equal to 28x on $3.5 EPS. All calls came after the Oct 27 earnings release except the BofA rating, and four of five targets were raised or set after it; none has a documented 12-month horizon. Wolfe Research (initiation, Buy) and TD Cowen ($104 to $112) on Nov 17 are after the reference close and excluded.
